name: Word beats (one word per beat)
purpose: Kinetic sentence or manifesto delivered one word per cut, each word on its own full-frame card with a treatment that performs the word (rise, smear, drop, stretch, spin, track, echo, cut) and an optional accent full stop.

inputs.name: words
inputs.description: [{text, treatment, bg, ink, accent, side, stretch}]; stretch is the start scaleX of the 'stretch' treatment (2.6); lower it when frame 0 must stay inside narrow formats

inputs.name: beats
inputs.description: One time per word plus the end, or a tempo grid

inputs.name: holdLast
inputs.description: Keep the last card visible after its beat

inputs.name: fit
inputs.description: Shrink each word to the safe width

implementation.api: Studio.comp.wordBeats(parent, words, {beats, holdLast, fit}).schedule(tl) -> end time

layout_notes: Each card fills its parent; the word is centred and fitted to the safe width of the current format (Studio.type.fit), so portrait gets a smaller size rather than a crop. Background and ink per card come from style tokens or explicit colours.
validation_steps: python scripts/frame-review.py tests/reference-derived/word-beats/index.html --fonts google (check every card is readable for its beat)
npx hyperframes check on the render host

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test (exactly one card per beat, tempo-grid timing, accent dot, echo copies, last card holds) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
